title: Review of c04's crawler minimum-motile-size finding: replicated on seed 3 (R=8 stops by t~80, R=10 by t~160, R=12 crawls 17.7 BL; sigma 1.3/alpha 4 rescues R=8)
summary: Verdict written before reading other reviews. I read probe/speeds.txt and looked at static_daughters/sheet.png, then ran the positive-control crawler world (GROW=0) unchanged except the target radius on new seed 3, measuring speed every 20 t (speed.py, speeds_seed3.txt), plus labkit packs at R0=12 and R0=8 (rerun_R12/seed3, rerun_R8/seed3, T=500). Speeds: R0=8 0.78 -> 0 by t~80; R0=10 0.87 -> 0 by t~160; R0=12 steady 0.79; R0=8 with sigma=1.3, alpha=4 steady 0.95. labkit: R0=12 travels 17.7 body lengths; R0=8 2.2 body lengths and then sits as a round cell (rerun_R8/seed3/sheet.png). The numbers match c04's seed-0 probe almost exactly, so the threshold is robust to the seed (the seed sets only the kick and noise).

observations.finding: speeds_seed3.txt; rerun_R12/seed3/FACTS.md 17.7 BL vs rerun_R8/seed3/FACTS.md 2.2 BL; rerun_R8/seed3/sheet.png the R=8 cell rounds and stops

controls_run.finding: rerun_R8/seed3 vs rerun_R12/seed3 (matched, only R0 differs)

verdicts.limitation: The threshold sits between R=10 and R=12 at alpha=3, sigma=0.6, with R=10 decaying slowly (t~160), so 'crawls indefinitely' for R=12 is tested only to t=500. I did not scan sigma/alpha further or check dt/resolution; a single kick protocol.
